quarterly_data.quarter: Infineon press release: Infineon acquires C2i Semiconductors to expand its (08-24-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Infineon announced the acquisition of C2i Semiconductors, a Bangalore-based company specializing in software-defined multiphase controllers and smart power stages for AI data center applications, adding expertise in digital power management and system-level vertical power delivery architectures, including future Substrate Integrated Voltage Regulators (SIVR); closing is expected in the third quarter of calendar year 2026. Adam White, President of the Power Systems division: it will 'accelerate innovation in power delivery solutions for AI data centers' and 'expand our capabilities in next-generation vertical power delivery architectures'.
quarterly_data.figure: no specific figure; closing expected in Q3 of calendar 2026
